'''X-5''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Target" /> [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who, along with six other men, was hired by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]] to participate in [[Project Omega]]. The operation was an experiment by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to create the perfect assassin. Soresh cleared the participants' identities from a [[Computer/Legends|database system]] and altered their faces surgically. He then started his reconditioning program, which was designed to turn them into mindless servants by removing their memories and emotions.<ref name="Trapped">''[[Rebel Force: Trapped]]''</ref>

At first, X-5 became friends with [[X-1 (assassin)|X-1]], [[X-2]], [[X-3]], [[X-4]], [[X-6]], and [[X-7]], the other participants in the training program. However, after Soresh started torturing them with [[Torture/Legends|electrocution]], X-5, like the others, had their personality and [[Brain/Legends|mind]] changed until they felt no emotions.<ref name="Target" /> Around [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the trainees were pitted against each other until only one remained. X-5 malfunctioned and began muttering about alliances. They encouraged the others to see Soresh as their enemy. Just before all of X-7's emotions had gone, he [[Death/Legends|killed]] X-5, earning the right to become Soresh's assassin.<ref name="Target" />

==Behind the scenes==
X-5 first appeared in a flashback sequence in ''[[Rebel Force: Target]]'', the first book of the young readers series ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Force]]'', published in [[2008]] and written by [[Alex Wheeler]].<ref name="Target" />
